+    return REQUIRED_MEASUREMENT_SCOPES <= frozenset(scopes)

+

+from typing import Any
+
+from intelligence.services.product_value.contracts import (
+    ACTIVITY_TIMER_SCOPE,
+    REQUIRED_MEASUREMENT_SCOPES,

+)
